new_content.name: Golden Wheat Seeds
new_content.how_to_obtain: Craft: 8 wheat seeds around 1 gold ingot (yields 8)
new_content.notes: Feed to a chicken for a chance at a Golden Egg; feed to a baby chicken to grow it instantly.

new_content.name: Golden Egg
new_content.how_to_obtain: Chance from a chicken fed Golden Wheat Seeds
new_content.notes: Food equal to a golden carrot.

new_content.name: Golden Cactus
new_content.notes: Grows like a cactus. Feed to a camel to regrow a pulled-off snout, or to a baby camel to grow it up instantly.

new_content.name: Camel snout
new_content.how_to_obtain: Drops (as a miniblock/head item) when a leashed adult camel lags too far behind and has its snout ripped off (small chance)

new_content.name: Zombie Cod / Zombie Salmon / Zombie Tropical Fish
new_content.how_to_obtain: A leashed fish that dies out of water
new_content.notes: Hostile, 1 heart, sunlight-immune, poisonous tail-slap bite; it moves toward you with leash attached.

new_content.name: Livna (upside-down anvil)
new_content.how_to_obtain: Craft: 3 iron ingots on top row, 1 iron ingot in the middle, 3 iron blocks on bottom row
new_content.notes: Falls upward, damaging things above. Wears to Chipped Livna then Damaged Livna like an anvil.

new_content.name: Upside-Down Bed (16 colors)
new_content.how_to_obtain: Craft: row of 3 planks on top, row of 3 same-color wool below
new_content.notes: Hangs from the ceiling. Sleeping in one turns day to night. White uses any wool.

new_content.name: Upside-Down Chest
new_content.notes: Functions as a chest. Craft it back alone to get a normal chest.

new_content.name: Upside-Down Crafting Table
new_content.notes: Functions as a crafting table; reversible the same way.

mechanics.title: Leashed fish
mechanics.description: Leads can be attached to fish (they still need water).

mechanics.title: Advancements
mechanics.description: The mod adds a small advancement tab (10 advancements, e.g. Pull Snout, Fish Out of Water, Nap Time).

vanilla_changes.change: Shapeless: upside-down crafting table -> crafting table

getting_started: Craft Golden Wheat Seeds and feed a chicken, or craft an upside-down bed to skip the day.
editor_notes: Author's own mod (chimericdream). Livna pattern: 'iii' / ' i ' / 'III' (i=iron ingot, I=iron block). 22 loot tables included (block drops). Verify bed/day-night behavior in-game.
name: Camel Nostrils
summary: A deliberately absurd mod by the pack author with ideas from non-player spouses: pull-off camel snouts, zombie fish, golden foods, and upside-down versions of beds, chests, crafting tables and anvils.
